#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;

long long modAdd(long long a, long long b) {
    long long v = a + b;
    return v < MOD ? v : v - MOD;
}

long long modMul(long long a, long long b) {
    return (a * b) % MOD;
}

long long modMul(long long a, long long b, long long c) {
    return modMul(modMul(a, b), c);
}

long long modPow(long long x, int e) {
    if (e == 0) return 1;
    if (e < 0) {
        // Not used in this problem
        return 1;
    }
    long long res = 1;
    while (e) {
        if (e & 1) res = modMul(res, x);
        x = modMul(x, x);
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

long long modInv(long long value) {
    long long g = MOD, x = 0, y = 1;
    for (long long r = value; r != 0; ) {
        long long q = g / r;
        g %= r;
        long long temp = g;
        g = r;
        r = temp;
        x -= q * y;
        temp = x;
        x = y;
        y = temp;
    }
    return (x % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
}

vector<long long> fact = {1};
vector<long long> invFact = {1};

long long factN(int n) {
    while ((int)fact.size() <= n) {
        fact.push_back(modMul(fact.back(), (int)fact.size()));
    }
    return fact[n];
}

long long fInv(int n) {
    int lastKnown = (int)invFact.size() - 1;
    if (lastKnown < n) {
        int len = n - lastKnown;
        vector<long long> fInvArr(len);
        fInvArr[0] = modInv(factN(n));
        for (int i = 1; i < len; i++) {
            fInvArr[i] = modMul(fInvArr[i - 1], n - i + 1);
        }
        for (int i = len - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            invFact.push_back(fInvArr[i]);
        }
    }
    return invFact[n];
}

long long ncr(int n, int r) {
    if (r < 0 || n < r) return 0;
    return modMul(factN(n), modMul(fInv(r), fInv(n - r)));
}

long long paritySign(long long k) {
    return (k & 1) == 0 ? 1 : MOD - 1;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    long long k;
    cin >> n >> k;

    if (k == 0) {
        cout << factN(n) << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    if (k > n - 1) {
        cout << 0 << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    int c = (int)(n - k);
    long long answer = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= c; i++) {
        long long term = modMul(paritySign(c - i), ncr(c, i), modPow(i, n));
        answer = modAdd(answer, term);
    }

    answer = modMul(answer, 2, ncr(n, c));
    cout << answer << '\n';

    return 0;
}
